edits.before: Q the pair — the tornado tick chips duos that stand in formation.
edits.after: Dredge Line (Q) hooks you or your ADC into his Staggering Blow (P) root before your slow Justice Punch (E) windup can even start — he owns first contact.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: A landed hook plus his passive root chains enough CC for his ADC to convert a kill — hold W Shield of Durand for the follow-up and never stand behind a minion he can pull through.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: His chain CC still out-locks anything you can answer — if he lands Q on you mid-dash, Dredge Line denies your Justice Punch (E) outright, so bait it on a minion first.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: Riptide (E) and the Dredge Line-into-root chain keep you pinned and behind; play back and refuse to face-check brush where his Q lands for free.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance flashes past his hook range to dive the backline, and your W channel eats his Riptide (E)/Depth Charge (R) return poke while you knock up his carry.

edits.before: First item: the taunt rotation chunks and the MR makes mage supports cry.
edits.after: He re-spikes with first item: Dredge Line (Q) into Depth Charge (R) can re-lock your engage, so don't over-extend when his Q is up.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.
edits.after: Your AoE Hero's Entrance and Q slow answer his single-target Depth Charge (R) in the 2v2, and once his hook is baited on a minion your team collapses faster than his chain CC can lock a target.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line (Hook): matchup-defining — His only real engage — dodge it and the lane is free. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shield of Durand banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Dredge Line (Q) is 14s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — dodge it and the lane is free until it's back. Depth Charge (R) is 120s at rank 1, so a used ult is a long window; note it also grounds your Justice Punch (E) if it lands on you mid-dash.
